## C058 bounded documentation/metadata validation window

Owner `interactive-reach06-accounting-authority-20261028-c058-7f2a` holds this exclusive validation, packaging and publication window from observed 2026-10-28 16:47 UTC until 17:17 UTC, unless explicitly released earlier. No main integration lease is acquired.

The actual reviewed source cut is `4a84fccf416775a170849d0c2e54cfb0e3e78c96`, tree `133ec21e4ca5ae4879f6c86d00315a5f74038b11`, on the owned C058 branch. Its 42 additions have exact Git-blob/size/mode bindings; all 3,118 C057 parent files are preserved. Three final reviews bind the exact seven core inputs and pass 111 substantive checks, with zero unresolved document findings. A separate evidence review passes 16 static validation-script checks. All three assisting workers have explicitly paused; no recovery, transfer, runtime or background command is active.

Selected execution is only the unchanged documentation preservation/link checker and the reviewed C058 metadata auditor, followed by immutable publication readback and portable handoff packaging. Commands record exact source cut, interpreter/platform, before/after input identities, actual output and exit status. The two postprocessed summary JSONs and each command's own result directories are explicitly excluded from stable input manifests. Failed attempts, if any, remain separate.

No product import, endpoint, numerical replay, original/candidate request, collector, runtime test, benchmark, archived-driver execution, hosted dispatch or integration is selected. M1 remains UNADOPTED/HOLD; original28 remains24/28 historical, P11/P16/P23/L03 open, and C035 held including adverse timing. A later explicit release, not this expiry alone, will establish completion.
